title: The NRI's Guide to World Cup 2026 at SoFi Stadium, Los Angeles
excerpt: Match schedule including Team USA's group games, Artesia's Little India on Pioneer Blvd, LA Metro World Cup shuttles, and how SoCal's desi community can attend the biggest sporting event of the decade.
body:
Los Angeles is hosting the biggest matches of the group stage — including two Team USA games — at SoFi Stadium in Inglewood. With a quarterfinal also on the slate, SoFi is one of the premier World Cup venues. And LA's Artesia Little India is one of the best desi food corridors in the country.

Match Schedule

| Date | Match | Kickoff (PT) | |------|-------|-------------| | Thu, Jun 12 | USA vs Paraguay | 6:00 PM | | Sun, Jun 15 | Iran vs New Zealand | 6:00 PM | | Thu, Jun 18 | Switzerland vs Bosnia & Herzegovina | 12:00 PM | | Sat, Jun 21 | Belgium vs Iran | 12:00 PM | | Wed, Jun 25 | USA vs Turkey | 7:00 PM | | Sun, Jun 28 | Round of 32 (TBD) | TBD | | Thu, Jul 2 | Round of 32 (TBD) | TBD | | Fri, Jul 10 | Quarterfinal | TBD |

Where to Eat: Artesia's Pioneer Blvd Is the Move

Artesia Little India (30 min from SoFi): Pioneer Blvd between 183rd St and South St is the heart of SoCal's desi food scene. Jay Bharat for Gujarati thali on stainless steel platters. Udupi Palace for 3-foot paper masala dosas. Bhookhe for Rajasthani Maharaja thalis with 21+ items. Ambala Sweets for papdi chaat and jalebi — always a line, always worth it. Chennai Dosa Corner for 25 dosa varieties including mutton and keema options. Podi for Chettinad goat curry in an upscale sit-down setting.

Near SoFi (South Bay): Al-Noor in Lawndale (15 min away, 4.5 stars) for Indian-Pakistani halal — chicken tikka masala and garlic naan before the match.

Culver City (15 min): Mayura is the longtime staple. Arth Bar & Kitchen for modern Indian cocktails and weekend brunch. Almost Famous Indian in the Arts District for contemporary small plates.

Upscale/Special Occasion: Badmaash in DTLA for Indian gastropub vibes — chicken tikka poutine and craft cocktails. Spice Affair in Beverly Hills for a proper splurge.

Getting There: LA Metro Shuttles Are Incredible

Metro World Cup Shuttles ($1.75 each way): This is the best deal in sports. Dedicated nonstop buses to SoFi from 15+ locations across LA, running every 8-10 minutes starting 3-4 hours before kickoff. Key pickup spots: Hawthorne/Lennox Station (closest), LAX/Metro Transit Center, Union Station, Downtown Santa Monica, North Hollywood, and even Anaheim for Orange County fans.

Payment: TAP card, credit/debit, or Apple/Google Pay. That's it.

Driving: On-site parking must be pre-purchased and costs hundreds of dollars on match days. Prices increase 24 hours before each match. Skip it.

Rideshare: Fine getting there ($25-60), but post-match surge pricing is 3-5x. Use the Metro shuttle back instead.

Where to Stay

Inglewood/LAX Corridor: Maximum convenience. The Anthem hotel is directly across from SoFi. Multiple Hilton, Marriott, and Hyatt properties near LAX.

Culver City (15 min): Walkable, great restaurants, shuttle connection. The Culver Hotel is a 1924 landmark.

Koreatown (20-30 min): 24-hour neighborhood, KBBQ, nightlife, and it's the geographic center of LA. The LINE LA has a rooftop pool.

Desi Community

Pioneer Blvd in Artesia is LA's undisputed Little India. Beyond restaurants, you'll find Indian grocery stores, jewelry shops, sari stores, and sweet shops along the strip. The Hindu Temple of Greater Los Angeles in Calabasas and BAPS Shri Swaminarayan Mandir in Chino Hills are the major temples in the area.

Tickets

Available at FIFA.com/tickets. The USA games (Jun 12 vs Paraguay, Jun 25 vs Turkey) will be the most expensive — expect $1,000+ for lower bowl seats.
author: Diaspora Desk
